title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
Let p_n be positive integers with p_n/n -> 0. Suppose real random variables R_n satisfy R_n=O_p(p_n/sqrt(n)).
Then R_n=o_p(1).
Proof. Since p_n/n -> 0, we also have p_n/sqrt(n) -> 0.
A stochastically bounded factor times this deterministic vanishing factor converges to zero in probability.
